AI.title_translation: 面向域泛化人脸防伪的视觉基础模型基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文通过基准测试发现，无需多模态模型，通过优化自监督视觉Transformer（如DINOv2），即可在人脸防伪任务中实现更高效、更强的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大模型（VLM）的FAS方法计算资源消耗过大且推理延迟高，且其效果受限于视觉特征质量，因此有必要探索高效且稳健的纯视觉基础模型基准。
AI.method: 对15种预训练视觉模型（CNN和ViT）进行系统基准测试，并提出了一套包含人脸防伪数据增强（FAS-Aug）、Patch级数据增强（PDA）和注意力加权Patch损失（APL）的优化框架。
AI.result: 所提纯视觉基准在MICO协议下达到SOTA水平，在数据受限的LSD协议下优于现有方法，且具有显著的计算效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了优化后的自监督视觉Transformer（特别是DINOv2）在FAS任务中表现卓越，在无需复杂多模态架构的情况下，实现了比现有方法更高效、更稳健的跨域泛化能力。
AI.translation: 人脸防伪（FAS）由于需要在未见过的环境中实现稳健的域泛化，因此依然具有挑战性。虽然近期的趋势是利用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行语义监督，但这些多模态方法通常需要极高的计算资源，并表现出较高的推理延迟。此外，它们的有效性本质上受限于底层视觉特征的质量。本文重新审视了纯视觉基础模型为FAS建立高效且稳健基准的潜力。我们对15种预训练模型（如监督式CNN、监督式ViT和自监督ViT）在MICO和有限源域（LSD）协议等严苛的跨域场景下进行了系统性基准测试。我们的全面分析表明，自监督视觉模型，特别是带有Registers的DINOv2，能显著抑制注意力伪影并捕获关键的细粒度防伪线索。结合人脸防伪数据增强（FAS-Aug）、Patch级数据增强（PDA）和注意力加权Patch损失（APL），我们提出的纯视觉基准在MICO协议中达到了最先进的性能。该基准在数据受限的LSD协议下优于现有方法，同时保持了卓越的计算效率。这项工作为FAS提供了一个明确的纯视觉基准，证明了优化后的自监督视觉Transformer可以作为纯视觉和未来多模态FAS系统的骨干网络。项目页面见：https://gsisaoki.github.io/FAS-VFMbenchmark-CVPRW2026/ 。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决人脸防伪（FAS）在跨域场景下的泛化难题。通过对15种主流视觉模型进行系统基准测试，研究发现自监督视觉Transformer（如DINOv2）能有效捕捉细粒度的欺诈特征。结合提出的FAS-Aug、PDA和APL策略，该方法在保持高计算效率的同时，在多个评估协议下实现了领先的性能。
AI.keywords: 人脸防伪, 视觉基础模型, 域泛化, 自监督学习, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统基准测试，有力地证明了纯视觉基础模型在人脸防伪（FAS）任务中的潜力，挑战了当前过度依赖多模态大模型的趋势。其创新点在于通过引入DINOv2等自监督模型结合特定的增强策略，在保证计算效率的同时实现了SOTA性能，为后续研究提供了极其重要的基准参考。

title: TSAssistant: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Automated Target Safety Assessment
comments: Updated with quantitative and expert evaluations
summary: Target Safety Assessment (TSA) requires systematic integration of genetic, transcriptomic, target homology, pharmacological, and clinical data to evaluate potential safety liabilities of therapeutic targets. This process is labor-intensive and expert-dependent, posing challenges in scalability and reproducibility. We present TSAssistant, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent framework that decomposes TSA report generation into a workflow of specialized subagents: Research Subagents that each ground and cite a single TSA domain, and Synthesis Subagents that integrate findings across domains. Subagents retrieve and synthesize evidence from curated biomedical sources through standardized tool interfaces and produce individually citable, evidence-grounded sections, with behavior shaped by a hierarchical instruction architecture that separates coordination logic from domain expertise and user intent. To complement these soft constraints, programmatic execution hooks and persistent memory stores enforce hard constraints across the workflow, while an interactive refinement loop allows experts to review and revise individual sections with full conversational context preserved across iterations. Rather than a single holistic comparison, we decompose report quality into reproducibility, evidential grounding, task-level accuracy, and controllability under expert oversight, finding high reproducibility and grounding, substantial agreement with the human reference, and net-positive expert-driven refinement.
comment: Updated with quantitative and expert evaluations

AI.title_translation: TSAssistant：一种用于自动化靶点安全评估的人机协同智能体框架
AI.tldr: TSAssistant 利用多智能体系统自动化药物靶点安全评估，通过专家参与的反馈循环，实现了高效、可追溯且高质量的评估报告生成。
AI.motivation: 药物靶点安全评估（TSA）需要整合多维复杂数据，目前高度依赖人工，导致过程繁琐、难以扩展且缺乏可重复性。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为 TSAssistant 的人机协同多智能体框架。该框架将任务分解为研究子智能体（负责特定领域的数据检索与引用）和综合子智能体（负责跨领域证据整合），并采用层级指令架构、程序化执行钩子和持久化存储来增强一致性，同时包含一个交互式反馈循环供专家进行修订。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该系统具有高可重复性和证据支撑度，生成的报告与人类专家参考标准高度一致，且通过专家反馈循环能显著提升报告质量。
AI.conclusion: TSAssistant 通过多智能体协作与人机交互反馈环，有效解决了药物靶点安全评估中劳动密集、可扩展性差的问题，实现了高可重复性和高准确性的自动化评估。
AI.translation: 靶点安全评估（TSA）需要系统地整合遗传学、转录组学、靶点同源性、药理学和临床数据，以评估治疗靶点的潜在安全风险。这一过程劳动密集且高度依赖专家，对可扩展性和可重复性提出了挑战。我们提出了 TSAssistant，这是一个人机协同的多智能体框架，将 TSA 报告生成分解为专业子智能体的工作流：研究子智能体负责每一个 TSA 领域的证据溯源与引用，综合子智能体负责跨领域的发现整合。子智能体通过标准工具接口从精选的生物医学资源中检索并合成证据，生成可逐一引用的、有证据支持的章节，其行为由将协调逻辑与领域专业知识及用户意图分离的分层指令架构所塑造。为了补充这些软约束，程序化执行钩子和持久化存储在工作流中强制执行硬约束，同时交互式优化循环允许专家在保持完整对话上下文的情况下审查和修订各个章节。我们没有进行单一的整体比较，而是将报告质量分解为可重复性、证据基础、任务级准确性和专家监督下的可控性，结果显示该系统具有高可重复性和证据支撑度，与人类参考标准高度一致，且专家驱动的优化具有净正向效果。
AI.summary: TSAssistant 是一个用于药物靶点安全评估的人机协作多智能体框架。通过将任务分解为专业的子智能体并结合分层指令与反馈机制，该系统能够高效地从生物医学数据中检索、整合证据并生成可追溯的评估报告，减轻了专家负担并提高了评估的科学性与可重复性。
AI.keywords: 靶点安全评估, 多智能体系统, 人机协同, 药物发现, 自动化报告生成
AI.comments: TSAssistant 通过多智能体架构成功将原本依赖专家经验的繁琐流程进行了标准化和自动化，尤其在可追溯性和证据支撑方面表现出色，为自动化药物靶点评估提供了一个高效且可控的范式。

title: Fisher Markets with Approximately Optimal Bundles and the Need for a PCP Theorem for PPAD
summary: We study the problem of computing a competitive equilibrium with approximately optimal bundles in Fisher markets with separable piecewise-linear concave (SPLC) utility functions, meaning that every buyer receives a $(1-δ)$-optimal bundle, instead of a perfectly optimal one. We establish the first intractability result for the problem by showing that it is PPAD-hard for some constant $δ> 0$, assuming the PCP-for-PPAD conjecture. This hardness result holds even if all buyers have identical budgets (competitive equilibrium with equal incomes), linear capped utilities, and even if we also allow $\varepsilon$-approximate clearing instead of perfect clearing, for any constant $\varepsilon < 1/9$. Importantly, we show that the PCP-for-PPAD conjecture is in fact required to show hardness for constant $δ$: showing PPAD-hardness for finding such approximate market equilibria in a broad class of markets encompassing those generated by our hardness result would prove the conjecture. This is the first natural problem where the conjecture is provably required to establish hardness for it.

AI.title_translation: Fisher市场中近似最优束与PPAD的PCP定理的需求
AI.tldr: 研究发现Fisher市场中寻找近似最优均衡在PPAD类中是困难的，且该结论与PCP-for-PPAD猜想在理论上紧密绑定。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究Fisher市场中，当买家获得近似最优束（而非完全最优）时，计算竞争均衡的计算复杂性，并验证PCP-for-PPAD猜想在其中的作用。
AI.method: 通过归约方法，证明了在SPLC效用函数下，寻找近似最优束的竞争均衡是PPAD-hard的，并分析了该问题与PCP-for-PPAD猜想的逻辑等价性。
AI.result: 证明了在某些常数δ下，寻找近似最优束的竞争均衡是PPAD-hard的；即使在同等预算、线性上限效用且允许ε-近似清算的情况下，硬度依然成立。此外，证明了该问题的硬度证明必然依赖于PCP-for-PPAD猜想。
AI.conclusion: 在Fisher市场中，寻找具有近似最优束的竞争均衡在PPAD类中是困难的，且这一结论依赖于PCP-for-PPAD猜想，该猜想对于证明此类问题的硬度是必不可少的。
AI.translation: 我们研究了Fisher市场中具有可分离分段线性凹（SPLC）效用函数的近似最优束竞争均衡计算问题，即每个买家获得一个(1-δ)最优束，而非完全最优束。我们首次证明了该问题的难解性，即在假设PCP-for-PPAD猜想成立的情况下，对于某些常数δ>0，该问题是PPAD-hard的。即使所有买家拥有相同的预算、线性上限效用，且允许任何常数ε<1/9的ε-近似清算，该硬度结果依然成立。重要的是，我们证明了要证明常数δ下的硬度，PCP-for-PPAD猜想实际上是必需的：证明在包含我们硬度结果所生成市场的广泛市场类别中寻找此类近似市场均衡的PPAD-hardness，将证明该猜想。这是第一个被证明需要该猜想来建立硬度的自然问题。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Fisher市场中买家获得近似最优束时的竞争均衡计算问题。研究发现，在SPLC效用函数下，该问题是PPAD-hard的。论文进一步指出，这一硬度结果依赖于PCP-for-PPAD猜想，并证明了对于该类市场而言，该猜想是建立硬度结论的必要前提。
AI.keywords: Fisher市场, 竞争均衡, PPAD-hard, PCP-for-PPAD猜想, 近似最优束
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了Fisher市场中近似均衡计算的复杂性，并首次将该问题与PCP-for-PPAD猜想直接联系起来，具有重要的理论深度。其创新之处在于证明了该猜想不仅是研究该问题的工具，更是该类问题硬度的必要条件，为计算复杂性理论提供了新的视角。

title: Federated Generation of Synthetic RNA-seq Data
summary: Access to genomic data is highly regulated due to its sensitive nature. While safeguards are essential, cumbersome data access processes pose a significant barrier to the development of AI methods for genomics. Synthetic data generation can mitigate this tension by enabling broader data sharing without exposing sensitive information. Synthetic genomic data are produced by training generative models on real data and subsequently sampling artificial data that preserves relevant statistics while limiting disclosures about the underlying individuals. In some settings, a single data holder may have sufficient data to train such generative models; however, in many applications data must be combined across multiple sites to achieve adequate scale. This need arises, e.g., in rare disease studies, where individual hospitals typically hold data for only a small number of patients. The solution we present in this paper enables multiple data holders to jointly train a synthetic data generator without revealing their raw data. Our approach combines secure multiparty computation (MPC) to ensure input privacy, so that no party ever discloses its data in unencrypted form, with differential privacy (DP) to provide output privacy by mitigating information leakage from the released synthetic data. We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method by generating high-utility synthetic datasets from multiple real RNA-seq cohorts in federated settings, showing that our approach enables privacy-preserving data synthesis even when data are distributed across institutions.

AI.title_translation: 联邦式合成RNA-seq数据生成
AI.tldr: 提出一种结合联邦学习、MPC和差分隐私的技术，在保护基因组数据隐私的同时，实现跨机构的高质量合成数据生成。
AI.motivation: 基因组数据具有高度敏感性，导致数据共享困难，阻碍了AI在基因组学中的应用。单一机构的数据量往往不足，因此需要一种既能保护隐私又能跨机构协作生成高质量合成数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种联邦生成模型，通过结合安全多方计算（MPC）确保输入数据的隐私性，并利用差分隐私（DP）来防止合成数据输出时的信息泄露，从而在多机构协作环境下实现数据合成。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够从多个实际RNA-seq队列中生成高可用性的合成数据集，并在跨机构联邦环境下成功实现了隐私保护下的数据合成。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了联邦学习框架结合MPC和DP能够在不泄露原始敏感数据的前提下，生成高可用性的合成RNA-seq数据，为跨机构基因组研究提供了可行的隐私保护解决方案。
AI.translation: 基因组数据的获取受到严格监管，因为其具有敏感性。虽然保护措施至关重要，但繁琐的数据访问流程给基因组学AI方法的发展带来了巨大障碍。合成数据生成可以通过在不暴露敏感信息的情况下实现更广泛的数据共享来缓解这种矛盾。合成基因组数据是通过在真实数据上训练生成模型，随后采样出既能保留相关统计特征，又能限制对个体信息披露的人工数据来产生的。在某些情况下，单个数据持有者可能拥有足够的数据来训练此类生成模型；然而，在许多应用中，必须将多个站点的数据结合起来才能达到足够的规模。这种需求出现在例如罕见病研究中，其中每家医院通常只拥有少量患者的数据。我们在本文中提出的解决方案使多个数据持有者能够共同训练合成数据生成器，而无需泄露其原始数据。我们的方法结合了安全多方计算（MPC）以确保输入隐私，确保任何一方都不会以未加密的形式披露其数据；并结合了差分隐私（DP）以通过减轻发布合成数据带来的信息泄露来提供输出隐私。我们通过在联邦设置下从多个真实RNA-seq队列生成高可用性的合成数据集，实证证明了所提方法的有效性，表明即使数据分布在不同机构，我们的方法也能实现隐私保护下的数据合成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于联邦学习的合成RNA-seq数据生成方法，通过集成安全多方计算（MPC）和差分隐私（DP），在保障多机构数据隐私的前提下，实现了高质量合成基因组数据的共同训练与生成。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 合成数据生成, RNA-seq, 安全多方计算, 差分隐私
AI.comments: 该论文有效地解决了基因组数据在隐私保护与科研共享之间的矛盾，通过联邦学习、安全多方计算（MPC）和差分隐私（DP）的结合，为处理敏感生物医学数据提供了一种鲁棒的框架。其创新点在于将多方隐私计算应用于合成数据生成，特别适用于罕见病等样本稀缺的场景。

title: Utility-Aware DRL-Based TXOP Adaptation for NR-U and Wi-Fi Coexistence Networks
comments: 15 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables, submitted to IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society
summary: The coexistence of NR-U and Wi-Fi in the unlicensed spectrum introduces a challenging resource management problem, where heterogeneous channel access mechanisms can lead to unbalanced spectrum utilization and severe Wi-Fi performance degradation. To address this issue, this paper proposes a utility-aware deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for adaptive transmission opportunity (TXOP) control in NR-U/Wi-Fi coexistence networks. The coexistence process is formulated as a Markov decision process (MDP), in which the NR-U TXOP duration is treated as a controllable variable for regulating post-access channel occupancy. A deep Q-network (DQN) is then employed to learn adaptive TXOP control policies through online interaction with the coexistence environment. A key feature of the proposed framework is the integration of a configurable reward and criterion design, which enables explicit control of the fairness-efficiency-utility tradeoff. Three operating policies are developed, namely absolute fairness, moderate fairness, and utility-oriented moderate fairness, to characterize different coexistence operating points. Simulation results show that the proposed framework achieves a Jain fairness index above 0.9 under strict fairness control. Compared with the absolute fairness policy, the moderate fairness policy improves aggregate throughput by 68.22%, while the utility-oriented policy achieves a 177.6% improvement under the adopted utility evaluation metric. These results demonstrate that the proposed utility-aware DRL framework provides an effective and flexible solution for adaptive TXOP control and tradeoff management in heterogeneous unlicensed coexistence networks.

AI.title_translation: 基于效用感知的NR-U与Wi-Fi共存网络DRL TXOP自适应方案
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于深度强化学习的TXOP自适应控制框架，在NR-U与Wi-Fi共存网络中平衡了公平性与系统性能。
AI.motivation: NR-U与Wi-Fi在非授权频段共存时，由于信道接入机制的异构性，导致频谱利用不平衡以及Wi-Fi性能严重下降，亟需一种自适应的资源调度机制。
AI.method: 将共存过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），利用深度Q网络（DQN）学习TXOP控制策略，并设计了包含公平性、效率和效用权衡的配置化奖励函数。
AI.result: 在严格公平控制下，Jain公平指数超过0.9；与绝对公平策略相比，中度公平策略将总吞吐量提高了68.22%，效用导向策略在特定指标下提升了177.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的效用感知DRL框架在NR-U/Wi-Fi共存网络中实现了有效的TXOP控制，在保证公平性的前提下显著提升了系统吞吐量和整体效用，验证了DRL在异构非授权频谱管理中的优越性。
AI.translation: NR-U与Wi-Fi在非授权频段的共存引发了具有挑战性的资源管理问题，其中异构的信道接入机制可能导致频谱利用不平衡及Wi-Fi性能严重下降。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种用于NR-U/Wi-Fi共存网络中自适应传输机会（TXOP）控制的效用感知深度强化学习（DRL）框架。共存过程被建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中NR-U TXOP持续时间被视为调节接入后信道占用的可控变量。随后采用深度Q网络（DQN）通过与共存环境的在线交互来学习自适应TXOP控制策略。该框架的一个关键特征是集成了可配置的奖励和准则设计，能够显式控制公平性-效率-效用之间的权衡。文中开发了三种操作策略，即绝对公平、中度公平和效用导向的中度公平，以表征不同的共存操作点。仿真结果表明，该框架在严格的公平控制下实现了超过0.9的Jain公平指数。与绝对公平策略相比，中度公平策略将总吞吐量提高了68.22%，而效用导向策略在采用的效用评估指标下实现了177.6%的提升。这些结果表明，所提出的效用感知DRL框架为异构非授权共存网络中的自适应TXOP控制和权衡管理提供了一种有效且灵活的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于效用感知的深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于解决NR-U与Wi-Fi在非授权频段共存时的TXOP自适应控制问题。通过DQN实现动态策略学习，并结合灵活的奖励机制，成功在公平性、效率和效用之间实现了平衡。
AI.keywords: 非授权频谱, NR-U/Wi-Fi共存, 深度强化学习, TXOP自适应, 资源管理
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入基于效用的DRL框架，有效地解决了NR-U与Wi-Fi在非授权频段共存时的资源分配冲突问题。其创新点在于将公平性、效率和效用之间的权衡显式地集成到奖励设计中，为动态网络环境下的资源优化提供了灵活的策略。

title: Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Risk Factors from Retinal Images via Deep Learning: Development and Validation of Biologically Relevant Morphological Associations in the UK Biobank
comments: Accepted to the "Journal of Alzheimer's Disease" for publication
summary: The systemic, metabolic, lifestyle factors have established associations with Alzheimer's Disease (AD) through epidemiologic and AD-specific biomarker studies. Whether colored fundus photography (CFP) contains retinal structural signatures corresponding to these AD-related risk domains remains unclear. To determine whether deep learning (DL) models can predict 12 AD-related risk factors from CFP and to characterize the retinal structures underlying these predictions, thereby assessing whether CFP reflects pathways to AD vulnerability. Using 62,876 CFPs from 44,501 unique participants from the UK Biobank, DL models were trained to predict 12 factors linked to AD incidence: 6 categorical (sex, smoking, sleeplessness, economic status, alcohol use, depression) and 6 continuous (age, age at completing education, BMI, systolic, diastolic blood pressure, HbA1c). Model performance, model saliency, and saliency-derived scores (CAM-Score) were evaluated and compared to retinal morphometry. The scores were also compared between incident-AD cases (average 8.55 years before onset) and matched controls. Performance of DL ranged from AUROC= 0.5654-0.9480 for categorical and R2=-0.0291-0.7620 for continuous factors, outperforming most of the morphometry-machine learning models. Saliency-based score consistently highlighted biologically meaningful regions, particularly the optic nerve head and retinal vasculature. It also aligned with present morphometric variations. Several saliency-based scores differed significantly between incident AD and matched controls, suggesting potential overlap between retinal correlates of risk factors and preclinical AD-associated changes. CFP encodes retinal signatures linked to AD risk factors. Although not diagnostic, DL-derived retinal representations may uncover biologically meaningful risk-related structural changes mirroring the potential AD vulnerability.
comment: Accepted to the "Journal of Alzheimer's Disease" for publication

AI.title_translation: 通过深度学习从视网膜图像预测阿尔茨海默病风险因素：英国生物样本库中生物学相关形态学关联的开发与验证
AI.tldr: 该研究证明了视网膜图像中蕴含与阿尔茨海默病风险因素相关的结构特征，通过深度学习模型可有效识别这些特征，为评估AD风险提供了非侵入性视网膜生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 尽管流行病学研究已确定多种代谢和生活方式因素与阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关，但目前尚不清楚彩色眼底照片（CFP）是否包含与这些AD风险领域对应的视网膜结构特征。本研究旨在验证深度学习模型是否能从CFP中预测这些风险因素，并探究视网膜结构是否反映了AD的易感性。
AI.method: 利用英国生物样本库（UK Biobank）中的62,876张彩色眼底照片（CFP），训练深度学习模型来预测12个与AD相关的风险因素（6个分类变量和6个连续变量），并通过模型显著性图（Saliency maps）和CAM-Score分析视网膜结构特征，最后将这些评分与AD发病病例及对照组进行对比。
AI.result: 深度学习模型在预测12个风险因素方面表现出色，分类变量的AUROC在0.5654至0.9480之间，连续变量的R2在-0.0291至0.7620之间，优于大多数基于视网膜形态学的机器学习模型。显著性评分突出了视网膜中的视神经乳头和视网膜血管等生物学相关区域，且在AD发病前约8.55年的病例与对照组之间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜图像确实编码了与AD风险因素相关的结构特征，深度学习方法能够提取这些具有生物学意义的特征，为评估AD易感性提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: 全身、代谢和生活方式因素已通过流行病学和AD特异性生物标志物研究与阿尔茨海默病（AD）建立了既定关联。彩色眼底照片（CFP）是否包含与这些AD相关风险领域对应的视网膜结构特征尚不清楚。本研究旨在确定深度学习（DL）模型是否能从CFP中预测12个AD相关风险因素，并描述这些预测背后的视网膜结构，从而评估CFP是否反映了AD易感性的通路。利用英国生物样本库中44,501名参与者的62,876张CFP，训练DL模型以预测与AD发病相关的12个因素：6个分类变量（性别、吸烟、睡眠、经济状况、饮酒、抑郁）和6个连续变量（年龄、完成教育年龄、BMI、收缩压、舒张压、HbA1c）。对模型性能、模型显著性和基于显著性的评分（CAM-Score）进行了评估，并与视网膜形态测量学进行了比较。同时比较了AD发病病例（平均发病前8.55年）和匹配对照组之间的评分。DL的性能在分类因素的AUROC=0.5654-0.9480和连续因素的R2=-0.0291-0.7620之间，优于大多数形态测量-机器学习模型。基于显著性的评分始终突出了具有生物学意义的区域，特别是视神经乳头和视网膜血管。它也与现有的形态测量学变异相一致。几个基于显著性的评分在AD发病病例和匹配对照组之间存在显著差异，表明风险因素的视网膜相关性与临床前AD相关变化之间可能存在重叠。CFP编码了与AD风险因素相关的视网膜特征。虽然不能作为诊断依据，但基于DL的视网膜表征可能揭示具有生物学意义的风险相关结构变化，反映了潜在的AD易感性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用深度学习分析英国生物样本库的视网膜图像，成功预测了12个与阿尔茨海默病相关的风险因素。研究发现，视网膜图像中包含与这些风险因素及AD易感性相关的结构特征，特别是视神经乳头和血管区域，表明视网膜成像在AD早期风险评估中具有潜在的生物学价值。
AI.keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 视网膜图像, 深度学习, 风险因素, 生物标志物
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地利用深度学习挖掘视网膜图像与阿尔茨海默病风险因素之间的深层联系，不仅验证了视网膜成像的生物学相关性，还为早期AD风险评估提供了一种非侵入性的潜在筛查工具。其局限在于模型在某些连续变量上的预测表现较弱，且目前的研究结果尚不足以作为临床诊断依据。

title: Information Theory and Statistical Learning
summary:
This manuscript contains preprint of a chapter under consideration for inclusion in the forthcoming third edition of {\em Cover and Thomas's Elements of Information Theory}, posted with permission from Wiley. The table of contents EIT-3 ToC of the new edition can be found at: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L-m4oQEJw1PJhoxBeMwrrBD8S_HmvzMEkPbYvS24980/edit?usp=sharing . For feedback, please contact abbas@ee.stanford.edu
  Learning and information theory intersect in both model training and the characterization of fundamental performance limits. This manuscript provides a concise and accessible treatment of the first intersection, requiring only basic background in information theory and statistics at the senior undergraduate or first-year graduate level. End-of-chapter exercises make the material well suited for classroom use as well as self-study.
  The chapter focuses on the role of divergence measures in model training, with examples ranging from linear and logistic regression to autoregressive models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, generative adversarial networks, and score-based models. It introduces the evidence lower bound (ELBO), f-divergences, and the Fisher divergence. In particular, the treatment of the generative diffusion model provides a more systematic and explicit derivation than is typical in the literature.

AI.title_translation: 信息论与统计学习
AI.tldr: 本文通过信息论中的散度度量和ELBO框架，为包括扩散模型在内的现代统计学习模型提供了系统性的数学推导与分析。
AI.motivation: 旨在探讨信息论与统计学习在模型训练及性能极限表征上的交叉点，为相关领域提供一份易于理解、适合教学的参考资料。
AI.method: 采用了基于发散度量（如f-散度、Fisher散度）的分析方法，通过ELBO（证据下界）推导和统一框架，对线性回归、逻辑回归、自回归模型、VAE、GAN及扩散模型进行建模和分析。
AI.result: 不仅涵盖了传统回归模型，还为生成式扩散模型提供了比现有文献更系统、更明确的数学推导，证明了信息论工具在现代深度学习模型分析中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入发散度量、ELBO以及Fisher散度等概念，该文成功地为现代统计学习模型（特别是生成模型）提供了一个统一且严谨的信息论解释框架。
AI.translation: 本手稿收录了《信息论基础》（Cover and Thomas著）第三版中拟收录的一章。学习理论与信息论在模型训练和基本性能极限的表征上存在交集。本手稿对这一交集进行了简洁且易于理解的论述，仅需具备高年级本科或研究生一年级水平的信息论与统计学基础。章末习题使该材料非常适合课堂教学和自学。本章重点讨论了发散度量在模型训练中的作用，示例涵盖了从线性回归、逻辑回归到自回归模型、变分自编码器、扩散模型、生成对抗网络及基于分数模型。文中介绍了证据下界（ELBO）、f-散度和Fisher散度。特别是对生成式扩散模型的处理，提供了比现有文献更系统、更明确的推导。
AI.summary: 本文作为《信息论基础》第三版的一章，系统阐述了信息论与统计学习的交集。文章重点探讨了发散度量在模型训练中的作用，涵盖了从传统回归到现代生成模型（如扩散模型、VAE、GAN）的广泛应用，并提供了ELBO、f-散度和Fisher散度的详细理论分析。
AI.keywords: 信息论, 统计学习, 生成模型, 散度度量, 扩散模型
AI.comments: 该论文是经典教材《信息论基础》第三版的一个章节预印本，旨在弥合信息论与统计学习之间的鸿沟。其创新性在于将复杂的生成模型（如扩散模型）纳入信息论的分析框架中，提供了一种系统且易于理解的视角，非常适合教学和自学。

title: Neural networks as fuzzy logic formulas
summary: Neural networks are a fundamental aspect of modern artificial intelligence, playing a key role in various important machine learning architectures including transformers and graph neural networks. Recently, logical characterisations have been used to study the expressive power of many machine learning architectures, but logical characterisations of plain neural networks have received less attention. In this paper, we provide fuzzy logic characterisations of rational-weight ReLU-activated neural networks via Rational Pavelka logic ($\mathrm{RPL}$) and an extension of $\mathrm{RPL}$ called $\mathrm{RPL}(\odot)_{\leq 1}$, as well as two fragments of $\mathit{L Π} \frac{1}{2}$ called $\mathit{L Π} \frac{1}{2}(\rightarrow_{P}^-)_{\leq 1}$ and $\mathit{L Π} \frac{1}{2}(\odot^-, \rightarrow_{P}^-)$. The activation values of the neural networks are allowed to be arbitrary real numbers. We also provide fuzzy logic characterisations of a generalised polynomial ring over $\mathbb{Q}$ in countably many variables where the use of the ReLU-function is permitted via the fuzzy logic $\mathrm{RPL}(\odot)$ and a fragment of $\mathit{L Π} \frac{1}{2}$ called $\mathit{L Π} \frac{1}{2}(\rightarrow_{P}^-)$.

AI.title_translation: 作为模糊逻辑公式的神经网络
AI.tldr: 论文通过模糊逻辑系统（如RPL及其扩展）成功对具有有理权重和ReLU激活函数的神经网络进行了逻辑刻画。
AI.motivation: 虽然逻辑刻画常被用于研究现代机器学习架构，但针对普通神经网络的逻辑刻画研究较少，作者旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 通过引入Rational Pavelka logic (RPL) 及其扩展 RPL(⊙)≤1，以及 ŁΠ1/2 逻辑的特定片段，将具有有理权重和ReLU激活函数的神经网络形式化为逻辑公式。
AI.result: 证明了具有有理权重的ReLU神经网络可以被特定的模糊逻辑系统所刻画，并进一步将这种刻画扩展到了包含ReLU函数的广义多项式环。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功建立了一系列模糊逻辑系统，能够精确刻画具有有理权重和ReLU激活函数的神经网络，为神经网络的逻辑表达奠定了理论基础。
AI.translation: 神经网络是现代人工智能的基础，在Transformer和图神经网络等多种重要机器学习架构中发挥着关键作用。最近，逻辑刻画已被用于研究许多机器学习架构的表达能力，但普通神经网络的逻辑刻画受到的关注较少。在本文中，我们通过有理Pavelka逻辑 (RPL) 及其扩展 RPL(⊙)≤1，以及 ŁΠ1/2 的两个片段 ŁΠ1/2(→P−)≤1 和 ŁΠ1/2(⊙−, →P−)，提供了有理权重ReLU激活神经网络的模糊逻辑刻画。神经网络的激活值可以是任意实数。我们还通过模糊逻辑 RPL(⊙) 和 ŁΠ1/2 的一个片段 ŁΠ1/2(→P−)，提供了在允许使用ReLU函数的情况下，关于可数个变量的 Q 上的广义多项式环的模糊逻辑刻画。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了普通神经网络与模糊逻辑之间的深层联系，证明了具有有理权重和ReLU激活函数的神经网络可以用包括RPL及其变体在内的多种模糊逻辑系统进行形式化刻画。该工作为理解神经网络的表达能力提供了逻辑层面的解释。
AI.keywords: 神经网络, 模糊逻辑, ReLU激活函数, 表达能力, 有理Pavelka逻辑
AI.comments: 该论文填补了神经网络与模糊逻辑之间理论联系的空白，通过逻辑刻画揭示了ReLU神经网络的表达能力。其创新性在于将神经网络的运算转化为逻辑公式，为理解深度学习模型的数学本质提供了新的视角。

title: Approximate Next Policy Sampling: Replacing Conservative Target Policy Updates in Deep RL
summary: We revisit a classic "chicken-and-egg" problem in reinforcement learning: to safely improve a policy, the value function must be accurate on the state-visitation distribution of the updated policy. That distribution over states is unknown and cannot be sampled for the purposes of training the value function. Conservative updates solve this problem, but at the cost of shrinking the policy update. This paper explores an alternative solution, Approximate Next Policy Sampling (ANPS), which addresses the problem by modifying the training distribution rather than constraining the policy update. ANPS is satisfied if the distribution of the training data approximates that of the next policy. To demonstrate the feasibility and efficacy of ANPS, we introduce Stable Value Approximate Policy Iteration (SV-API). SV-API modifies the standard approximate policy iteration loop to hold the target policy fixed while an iteratively updated behavioral policy gathers relevant experience. It only commits to a new policy once a convergence criterion has been met. If certain stability criteria are met, the update is guaranteed to be safe; otherwise, it remains no less safe than standard approximate policy iteration. Applying SV-API to PPO yields Stable Value PPO (SV-PPO), which matches or improves performance on high-dimensional discrete (Atari) and continuous control benchmarks while executing substantially larger target policy updates. These results demonstrate the viability of ANPS as a new solution to this classic challenge in RL.

title: Mitigating Simplicity Bias in OOD Detection through Object Co-occurrence Analysis
comments: This paper has been accepted by CVPR2026
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial for ensuring the reliability of deep learning models. Existing methods mostly focus on regular entangled representations to discriminate in-distribution (ID) and OOD data, neglecting the rich contextual information within images. This issue is particularly challenging for detecting near-OOD, as models with simplicity bias struggle to learn discriminative features in disentangled representations. The human visual system can use the co-occurrence of objects in the natural environment to facilitate scene understanding. Inspired by this, we propose an Object-Centric OOD detection framework that learns to capture Object CO-occurrence (OCO) patterns within images. The proposed method introduces a new OOD detection paradigm that understands object co-occurrence within an image by predicting disentangled representations for the test sample, then adaptively divides patterns into three scenarios based on object co-occurrence patterns observed in ID training data, and finally performs OOD detection in a divide-and-conquer manner. By doing so, OCO can distinguish near-OOD by considering the semantic contextual relationships present in their images, avoiding the tendency to focus solely on simple, easily learnable regions. We evaluate OCO through experiments across challenging and full-spectrum OOD settings, demonstrating competitive results and confirming its ability to address both semantic and covariate shifts. Code is released at https://github.com/Michael-McQueen/OCO.

AI.title_translation: 通过物体共现分析减轻OOD检测中的简化偏差
AI.tldr: 通过引入物体共现模式分析，OCO框架有效解决了OOD检测中因简化偏差导致的识别难题，实现了对复杂分布外数据的精准判别。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法往往忽视了图像中的丰富上下文信息，且受限于简化偏差，难以有效识别近分布外（Near-OOD）数据，因为模型倾向于仅关注简单、易学的特征。
AI.method: 提出了一种以物体为中心的OOD检测框架（OCO），通过预测图像的解耦表示，提取物体共现模式，并根据训练数据中的模式将测试样本划分为三种场景，最终采用分而治之的策略进行OOD检测。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，OCO框架在具有挑战性的全谱OOD设置中取得了竞争性的表现，能够有效识别语义偏移和协变量偏移，且优于现有主流方法。
AI.conclusion: OCO框架通过显式建模物体共现模式，有效缓解了简化偏差，不仅增强了模型对近分布外数据的辨别能力，还在处理语义偏移和协变量偏移方面展现了卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 分布外（OOD）检测对于确保深度学习模型的可靠性至关重要。现有方法大多侧重于利用常规的纠缠表示来区分分布内（ID）和OOD数据，而忽略了图像中丰富的上下文信息。对于检测近分布外数据而言，这一问题尤为严峻，因为具有简化偏差的模型难以在解耦表示中学习到判别性特征。人类视觉系统能够利用自然环境中的物体共现来促进场景理解。受此启发，我们提出了一种以物体为中心的OOD检测框架，旨在捕捉图像中的物体共现（OCO）模式。该方法引入了一种新的OOD检测范式，通过预测测试样本的解耦表示来理解图像内的物体共现，随后根据ID训练数据中观察到的物体共现模式将场景划分为三种情形，最后以分而治之的方式执行OOD检测。通过这种方式，OCO能够通过考虑图像中存在的语义上下文关系来区分近分布外数据，从而避免了仅关注简单、易学区域的倾向。我们在具有挑战性和全谱OOD设置的实验中评估了OCO，证明了其具有竞争力的结果，并证实了其解决语义偏移和协变量偏移的能力。代码已发布在 https://github.com/Michael-McQueen/OCO。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于物体共现（OCO）的OOD检测框架，旨在通过利用图像中的语义上下文关系来克服深度学习模型的简化偏差。该方法通过将图像分解为物体表示并分析其共现模式，实现了对近分布外数据的精确识别。
AI.keywords: 分布外检测, 简化偏差, 物体共现, 场景理解, 分而治之
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入人类视觉系统中的“物体共现”机制，巧妙地解决了深度学习中常见的简化偏差（Simplicity Bias）问题。其创新点在于将复杂的OOD检测任务拆解为基于物体共现模式的“分而治之”策略，在处理近分布外（Near-OOD）数据时表现出显著优势。这为提升模型在复杂场景下的鲁棒性提供了新的研究视角。

title: Model-Reference Adaptive Flight Control of a 95-mg Insect-Scale Flapping-Wing Aerial Robot
summary: Due to the system's scale and complex fabrication, the model describing the dynamics of a flapping-wing insect-scale aerial robot is subject to parameter uncertainty; for example, in the inertia matrix and the actuator mapping of the flier. Furthermore, due to its low inertia, this type of robot is greatly affected by stochastic and systematic disturbances during flight, including power-wire tension, gusts, and undesired aerodynamic forces produced by wing misalignment. Therefore, the high-performance execution of complex maneuvers at the subdecigram scale requires the robot to adapt its behavior to counteract disturbances and model uncertainty. Toward this objective, we introduce a model-reference adaptive control (MRAC) architecture for high-performance position control of flapping-wing robotic insects that can be modeled as rigid bodies in the three-dimensional (3D) space. In addition, we demonstrate how the implementation of a hybrid multiplicative extended Kálmán filter for estimating current and desired angular velocities during flight significantly dampens attitude vibrations, especially along the roll and pitch degrees of freedom (DOFs), and also improves flight performance. To show the suitability, functionality, and high performance of the proposed approach, we conducted real-time hovering and trajectory-tracking 6-DOF flight control experiments with a 95-mg insect-scale aerial robot.

AI.title_translation: 95毫克昆虫级扑翼飞行机器人的模型参考自适应飞行控制
AI.tldr: 针对微型扑翼机器人易受干扰及参数不确定性影响的问题，提出了一种结合MRAC与MEKF的控制策略，实现了95毫克飞行器的高性能稳定飞行。
AI.motivation: 由于扑翼机器人尺度极小且制造复杂，存在惯性矩阵和执行器映射等参数不确定性，且极易受到电源线张力、阵风及气动误差等随机或系统扰动的影响，现有的控制方法难以满足其高精度机动需求。
AI.method: 设计了一种针对3D刚体建模的扑翼机器人模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）架构，并引入混合乘性扩展卡尔曼滤波（MEKF）来估计角速度，以抑制姿态振动并改善飞行性能。
AI.result: 成功在95毫克的昆虫级扑翼机器人上实现了实时悬停和6自由度轨迹跟踪实验，显著降低了滚转和俯仰方向的姿态振动，并提升了整体飞行性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，所提出的MRAC架构结合MEKF状态估计，能够实现95毫克扑翼机器人在复杂扰动下的稳定悬停与轨迹跟踪，验证了该控制策略在微型机器人飞行控制中的高鲁棒性和实用性。
AI.translation: 由于系统的尺度和复杂的制造工艺，描述扑翼昆虫级飞行机器人动力学的模型存在参数不确定性（例如惯性矩阵和飞行器的执行器映射）。此外，由于其惯性极低，此类机器人在飞行过程中会受到随机和系统扰动的巨大影响，包括电源线张力、阵风以及机翼不对中产生的有害气动作用力。因此，在亚分克尺度下执行复杂机动的高性能要求机器人能够调整其行为以抵消扰动和模型不确定性。为了实现这一目标，我们引入了一种模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）架构，用于可建模为三维（3D）空间刚体的扑翼机器人昆虫的高性能位置控制。此外，我们演示了如何实现一种混合乘性扩展卡尔曼滤波器来估计飞行过程中的当前和期望角速度，从而显著抑制姿态振动（特别是在横滚和俯仰自由度上），并提高飞行性能。为了证明所提方法的适用性、功能性和高性能，我们对一台95毫克的昆虫级飞行机器人进行了实时悬停和轨迹跟踪的6自由度飞行控制实验。
AI.summary: 本文针对95毫克昆虫级扑翼机器人在参数不确定性和外部干扰下的控制难题，提出了一种模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）方案。通过结合混合乘性扩展卡尔曼滤波进行姿态估计，有效抑制了飞行振动并实现了高精度的6自由度悬停与轨迹跟踪。
AI.keywords: 扑翼机器人, 模型参考自适应控制, 扩展卡尔曼滤波, 飞行控制, 微型飞行器
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）与混合乘性扩展卡尔曼滤波（MEKF）应用于极小尺度的扑翼飞行器，有效解决了此类机器人因惯性极低、制造误差导致的参数不确定性和环境干扰问题。这是微型机器人飞行控制领域的重要进展。

title: Safety-Critical LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with On-Manifold Deterministic Protection Level
summary: In safety-critical scenarios, the protection level of the autonomous navigation system is crucial for enabling mobile robots to perform safe tasks. However, existing studies on probabilistic navigation systems for robots usually perform offline accuracy evaluations using limited datasets and assume that the results can be applied to unknown real-world environments. As a result, current autonomous mobile robots often lack protection levels for online safety assessment. To fill this gap, we propose a safety-critical LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) that provides deterministic protection levels based on on-manifold deterministic state estimation. By adopting the unknown but bounded assumption, we derive a neat closed-form relationship between point cloud noise and the uncertainty of the estimation from the iterated closest point algorithm. Using this relationship, we design an on-manifold ellipsoidal set-membership filter and implement it within the LIO system. Leveraging the properties of the set-membership filter, our system offers the feasible sets of the estimated locations as the deterministic protection levels, serving as safety references for the robots' downstream autonomous operations. The experimental results show that our system can provide effective deterministic online safety references for diverse robots in various environments.

AI.title_translation: 具有流形上确定性保护水平的安全关键型激光雷达-惯性里程计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型LIO系统，通过流形上集合成员滤波实时计算确定性保护水平，为机器人提供在线安全保障。
AI.motivation: 现有的概率导航系统通常依赖有限数据集的离线评估，难以保证未知真实环境下的安全性，且缺乏为自动驾驶机器人提供在线保护水平的能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于流形上确定性状态估计的LIO框架；利用未知但有界误差假设，推导了点云噪声与迭代最近点（ICP）算法估计不确定性之间的闭式关系；设计并实现了一种流形上椭球集合成员滤波器。
AI.result: 实验表明，该系统能够为多种机器人在不同环境下提供有效的确定性在线安全参考，成功量化了估计位置的可行集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种具备确定性保护水平的LIO系统，通过集合成员滤波实现了对估计位置的可行域计算，为自动驾驶机器人的在线安全评估提供了可靠的理论与实践框架。
AI.translation: 在安全关键型场景中，自主导航系统的保护水平对于移动机器人执行安全任务至关重要。然而，现有的机器人概率导航系统研究通常使用有限数据集进行离线精度评估，并假设这些结果可以应用于未知的真实环境。因此，目前的自主移动机器人往往缺乏用于在线安全评估的保护水平。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种安全关键型激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO），它基于流形上的确定性状态估计提供确定性保护水平。通过采用“未知但有界”的假设，我们推导出了点云噪声与迭代最近点算法估计不确定性之间简洁的闭式关系。利用这种关系，我们设计了一种流形上椭球集合成员滤波器，并将其集成到LIO系统中。利用集合成员滤波的特性，我们的系统将估计位置的可行集作为确定性保护水平，为机器人的下游自主操作提供安全参考。实验结果表明，我们的系统能够为不同环境下的各类机器人提供有效的确定性在线安全参考。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种具有确定性保护水平的LiDAR-惯性里程计（LIO）系统。该方法通过引入流形上集合成员滤波，利用点云噪声的闭式关系，实时计算估计位置的可行集作为安全参考，有效解决了自动驾驶机器人在线安全评估缺失的问题。
AI.keywords: 激光雷达惯性里程计, 保护水平, 集合成员滤波, 自动驾驶安全, 流形估计
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将确定性保护水平（Deterministic Protection Level）引入到LiDAR-惯性里程计（LIO）中，填补了当前机器人导航系统缺乏在线安全评估的空白。其采用的流形上集合成员滤波方法，在处理未知但有界误差方面具有显著优势。局限性在于该方法可能对点云数据的噪声分布假设较为敏感。

title: Who embraces AI in play? Exploratory modeling of player preference profiles toward game AI
comments: Accepted to 2026 IEEE Conference on Games (IEEE CoG 2026)
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly entering digital games through diverse functions. While prior work has shown that player attitudes toward game AI are strongly context-dependent, less is known about how these attitudes are structurally combined within different groups of players. This study addresses this gap by modeling players' cross-context AI acceptance as interpretable attitude profiles. Based on questionnaire data from 771 digital game players, we apply Archetypal Analysis (AA) to centered acceptance ratings across eight representative AI application contexts in games. The analysis identifies seven distinctive profiles: AI-Skeptics, Broad AI-Supporters, Creative-Play Explorers, Experience-Oriented Supporters, Systemic Order Advocates, Emotion-Centered Supporters, and Governance-Skeptics. Exploratory one-vs-rest (OvR) logistic regressions further suggest that profile membership is associated with players' perceived AI literacy, gaming habits, disciplinary background, personality traits, and application-specific priorities. By shifting attention from isolated acceptance judgments to patterned preference structures, this study provides an exploratory empirical vocabulary for segmenting game AI audiences and offers preliminary design implications for more context-sensitive and player-sensitive AI integration in digital games.

AI.title_translation: 谁在游戏中拥抱AI？关于玩家游戏AI偏好画像的探索性建模
AI.tldr: 通过对771名玩家的调查，研究识别出七种不同的游戏AI偏好类型，揭示了玩家的态度倾向与个人特质及习惯的关联，为游戏AI的定制化设计提供了新视角。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单一情境下玩家对游戏AI的态度，缺乏对不同玩家群体中这些态度如何结构化组合的深入理解。
AI.method: 基于771名玩家的问卷数据，应用原型分析（Archetypal Analysis）对八个代表性AI应用情境的接受度评分进行建模，并使用一对多（OvR）逻辑回归分析各画像与玩家人口统计学及心理特征的关联。
AI.result: 识别出七类独特的玩家画像（如AI怀疑者、广泛支持者、创意游戏探索者等），并发现画像成员身份与玩家的AI素养、游戏习惯、学科背景、人格特质及应用优先级密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明玩家对游戏AI的态度并非单一维度，而是呈现出七种不同的偏好结构；玩家的画像归属与AI素养、游戏习惯、背景及个性特征显著相关，支持了游戏AI设计中更需关注“情境敏感性”与“玩家敏感性”的观点。
AI.translation: 人工智能正通过多种功能日益渗透进数字游戏中。尽管现有研究表明玩家对游戏AI的态度具有极强的情境依赖性，但对于这些态度如何在不同玩家群体中进行结构化组合，我们知之甚少。本研究通过将玩家跨情境的AI接受度建模为可解释的态度画像，填补了这一空白。基于771名数字游戏玩家的问卷数据，我们对八个代表性游戏AI应用情境的中心化接受度评分应用了原型分析（AA）。分析识别出了七种独特的画像：AI怀疑者、广泛AI支持者、创意游戏探索者、体验导向支持者、系统秩序倡导者、情感中心支持者以及治理怀疑者。探索性的一对多（OvR）逻辑回归进一步表明，画像归属与玩家的感知AI素养、游戏习惯、学科背景、人格特质以及特定应用优先级相关联。通过将注意力从孤立的接受度判断转向模式化的偏好结构，本研究为细分游戏AI受众提供了一个探索性的实证词汇，并为数字游戏中更具情境敏感性和玩家敏感性的AI整合提供了初步的设计启示。
AI.summary: 本文通过原型分析法对771名玩家进行研究，识别出七种关于游戏AI的偏好画像，揭示了玩家态度与个人背景及特质的深层联系，旨在为游戏AI的个性化与情境化设计提供理论与实证支持。
AI.keywords: 游戏AI, 玩家偏好, 原型分析, 态度画像, 用户细分
AI.comments: 该研究通过原型分析法（Archetypal Analysis）将玩家对游戏AI的态度细分为七种概括性的人格画像，这一方法论创新填补了以往研究仅关注单一语境下玩家态度评估的空白，为游戏AI的个性化设计提供了有价值的实证基础和分类框架。

title: Minimal Filling Architectures of Polynomial Neural Networks: Counterexamples, Frontier Search, and Defects
summary: We provide counterexamples to the unimodal minimal filling architecture conjecture for polynomial neural networks (PNNs) with power activation functions. Fixing the input and output widths, the conjecture states that any minimal filling architecture has unimodal widths for the hidden layers. We found counterexamples via a frontier search, recursive dimension bounds on neurovarieties, and symbolic computation. Notably, several subarchitectures of our main example exhibit large defect, in contrast with the predominantly small-defect behavior observed in prior literature.

title: CADBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation
summary: Recovering editable CAD programs from images or 3D observations is central to AI-assisted design, but progress is difficult to measure because existing evaluations are fragmented across datasets, modalities, and metrics. We introduce CADBench, a unified benchmark for multimodal CAD program generation. CADBench contains 18,000 evaluation samples spanning six benchmark families derived from DeepCAD, Fusion 360, ABC, MCB, and Objaverse; five input modalities including clean meshes, noisy meshes, single-view renders, photorealistic renders, and multi-view renders; and six metrics covering geometric fidelity, executability, and program compactness. STEP-based families are stratified by B-rep face count and all families are diversity-sampled to support controlled analysis across complexity and object variation. We benchmark eleven CAD-specialized and general-purpose vision-language systems, generating more than 1.4 million CAD programs. Under idealized inputs, specialized mesh-to-CAD models substantially outperform code-generating VLMs, which remain far from reliable CAD program reconstruction. CADBench further reveals three recurring failure modes: reconstruction quality degrades with geometric complexity, CAD-specialized models can be brittle under modality shift, and model rankings change across metrics. Together, these results position CADBench as a diagnostic testbed for measuring progress in editable 3D reconstruction and multimodal CAD understanding. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/anniedoris/CADBench.

AI.title_translation: CADBench：一个用于AI辅助CAD程序生成的多模态基准
AI.tldr: CADBench是一个统一的基准测试平台，旨在衡量AI生成可编辑CAD程序的能力，揭示了当前模型在处理复杂几何和不同输入模态时的性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI辅助CAD程序生成评估标准分散在不同的数据集、模态和指标中，缺乏统一的衡量标准，导致难以评估进展。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含18,000个评估样本的统一基准，涵盖5种输入模态（如网格、单/多视图渲染）、6种评估指标，并对11个模型进行了超过140万次程序生成的实验分析。
AI.result: 在理想输入下，专用网格转CAD模型优于通用视觉语言模型；研究揭示了模型在面对几何复杂性增加、模态转换时的脆弱性，以及不同指标下模型排名的不一致性。
AI.conclusion: CADBench作为一套全面的诊断测试平台，有效地量化了当前AI辅助CAD生成技术的瓶颈，为推动可编辑3D重建领域的发展奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 从图像或3D观测中恢复可编辑的CAD程序是AI辅助设计的核心，但由于现有评估标准分散在各种数据集、模态和指标中，进展难以衡量。我们引入了CADBench，这是一个用于多模态CAD程序生成的统一基准。CADBench包含18,000个评估样本，涵盖了源自DeepCAD、Fusion 360、ABC、MCB和Objaverse的六个基准系列；五种输入模态，包括干净网格、噪声网格、单视图渲染、真实感渲染和多视图渲染；以及六个涵盖几何保真度、可执行性和程序紧凑性的指标。基于STEP的系列按B-rep面数分层，所有系列均进行多样性采样，以支持对复杂性和对象变化的受控分析。我们对十一个CAD专用和通用视觉语言系统进行了基准测试，生成了超过140万个CAD程序。在理想输入下，专用网格转CAD模型大大优于代码生成的VLM，后者距离可靠的CAD程序重建仍有很大差距。CADBench进一步揭示了三种反复出现的失败模式：重建质量随几何复杂性而下降，CAD专用模型在模态转换下可能变得脆弱，以及模型排名随指标而变化。总之，这些结果将CADBench定位为衡量可编辑3D重建和多模态CAD理解进展的诊断测试平台。基准公开地址：https://github.com/anniedoris/CADBench。
AI.summary: CADBench是一个用于多模态CAD程序生成的统一基准，整合了多个数据集、输入模态和评估指标。通过对11个模型的广泛测试，该基准揭示了当前技术在处理复杂几何结构和模态迁移时的局限性，并为可编辑3D重建提供了标准化的评估工具。
AI.keywords: CAD生成, 多模态基准, 3D重建, 几何保真度, 模型评估
AI.comments: CADBench为AI辅助CAD设计领域提供了一个急需的统一评估框架。通过整合多种模态、数据集和评估指标，它不仅揭示了当前模型在复杂几何结构和模态迁移下的鲁棒性瓶颈，还为未来研究提供了明确的诊断工具。该基准的局限性在于其主要关注现有模型性能的量化，而模型如何从根本上克服这些复杂性尚需进一步探索。

title: How Creatives Approach GenAI Image Generation: Tensions Between Structured Guidance, Self-Experimentation, and Creative Autonomy
summary: As generative AI tools increasingly influence creative practice, they raise longstanding HCI questions about how creatives learn complex software and how they can be better supported. We conducted an interview study with artists and hobbyists (n=8) and a follow-up survey (n=159) to understand how this population approaches and seeks guidance for GenAI image tools. We found that creatives commonly use either self-experimentation or tutorials to explore GenAI tools, yet many struggle with confusing AI terminology. To gain further insight into creatives' learning experiences, we developed a research probe to elicit creatives' perceptions of structured guidance. Our user study with 17 creatives revealed that, even when creatives described the guidance as helpful for understanding AI, many still preferred self-experimentation, feeling that guidance could limit their creativity. Our findings highlight a central tension in supporting AI literacy for creatives: balancing guidance and promoting literacy while preserving creative freedom.

title: CogniFold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding
summary: Existing agent memory remains predominantly reactive and retrieval-based, lacking the capacity to autonomously organize experience into persistent cognitive structure. Toward genuinely autonomous agents, we introduce CogniFold, a brain-inspired "always-on" agent memory designed for the next generation of proactive assistants. CogniFold continuously folds fragmented event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures, bootstrapping progressively higher-level cognition from incoming events and accumulated knowledge. We ground this by extending Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory from two layers (hippocampus, neocortex) to three, adding a prefrontal intent layer. Emulating the prefrontal cortex as the locus of intentional control and decision-making, CogniFold achieves this through graph-topology self-organization: cognitive structures proactively assemble under the stream, merge when semantically similar, decay when stale, relink through associative recall, and surface intents when concept-cluster density crosses a threshold. We evaluate structural formation using CogEval-Bench, demonstrating that CogniFold uniquely produces memory structures that match cognitive expectations and concept emergence. Furthermore, across eight downstream benchmarks -- two probing long-term conversational memory (LoCoMo, LongMemEval) and six spanning other cognitive domains -- we validate that CogniFold simultaneously performs robustly on conventional memory tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenNorve/CogniFold.

title: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net: A Generalisable Mesh-Based Surrogate for Crashworthiness Field Prediction under Large Geometric Variation
comments: 48 pages, 15 figures, jounral paper under review
summary: Nonlinear finite element crash simulations are accurate but computationally expensive, limiting their use in iterative design optimisation. Machine-learning surrogate models based on graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a faster alternative. Message-passing GNNs are widely used for mesh simulation, and their shared node and edge update functions are relatively generalisable across varying graph structures. By contrast, non-shareable edge-specific aggregation layers can capture nonlinear relationships more accurately but usually require fixed graph connectivity, which limits generalisability. This paper presents Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet), a practical approach to addressing the limitation of hierarchical Graph U-Net architectures that use edge-specific downsampling and upsampling layers. Fixed coarse graph connectivity is required for edge-specific layers. To retain this while improving spatial correspondence, the proposed method morphs the coarsened graph hierarchy to each input mesh using feature-aligned barycentric parameterisation before constructing cross-graph edges. It further applies node masking during supervised pretraining, followed by parameter-efficient fine-tuning in which high-parameter edge-specific layers are frozen. The proposed approach is evaluated in in-distribution, out-of-distribution, and cross-component transfer settings using mean Euclidean distance and maximum intrusion percentage error. Results show that coarse-graph morphing improves test accuracy relative to a fixed-coarse-graph baseline, while masked supervised pretraining reduces the train-test discrepancy and improves data efficiency during transfer. The proposed model also achieves lower prediction error compared with external baselines. These results demonstrate a practical route toward reusable, data-efficient mesh-based surrogate modelling for crashworthiness design exploration.
comment: 48 pages, 15 figures, jounral paper under review

AI.title_translation: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net：一种用于大几何变化下碰撞性能场预测的通用网格代理模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型图神经网络架构MMGUNet，通过图变形技术和掩码预训练，有效解决了碰撞模拟中不同网格结构下的代理模型通用性与精度问题。
AI.motivation: 非线性有限元碰撞仿真计算代价高昂；现有的基于GNN的代理模型在处理不同网格拓扑时，往往在通用性（共享权重）与高精度（特定边聚合）之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet)架构，利用特征对齐的重心参数化技术对粗化图层级进行变形以适应不同输入网格；结合节点掩码监督预训练和参数高效的微调策略（冻结高参数边特定层）。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在分布内、分布外及跨组件迁移任务中均优于固定粗图基准模型，且在预测误差上低于外部基准，证明了其在碰撞设计探索中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net提供了一种高效、通用的网格代理模型构建方法，通过图变形和掩码预训练技术，显著提升了在几何变化较大的碰撞仿真场景下的预测精度与迁移能力。
AI.translation: 非线性有限元碰撞仿真虽然精确但计算成本高昂，限制了其在迭代设计优化中的应用。基于图神经网络（GNN）的机器学习代理模型提供了一种更快的替代方案。消息传递GNN被广泛用于网格模拟，其共享的节点和边更新函数在不同的图结构中具有较好的通用性。相比之下，不可共享的边特定聚合层能够更准确地捕捉非线性关系，但通常需要固定的图连接性，这限制了通用性。本文提出了Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet)，这是一种解决分层Graph U-Net架构局限性的实用方法，该架构使用边特定的下采样和上采样层。边特定层需要固定的粗图连接。为了在保留这一点的同时提高空间对应关系，所提方法在构建跨图边之前，使用特征对齐的重心参数化将粗化图层级变形为每个输入网格。它进一步在监督预训练期间应用节点掩码，随后进行参数高效的微调，其中高参数边特定层被冻结。所提方法在分布内、分布外和跨组件迁移设置中进行了评估，使用了平均欧几里得距离和最大侵入百分比误差。结果表明，粗图变形提高了相对于固定粗图基准的测试精度，而掩码监督预训练减少了训练-测试差异并提高了迁移过程中的数据效率。与外部基准相比，所提模型也实现了更低的预测误差。这些结果展示了实现可重用、数据高效的基于网格的碰撞性能设计探索代理建模的实用途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet)的网格代理模型，旨在解决碰撞仿真中几何变化大导致的通用性难题。通过引入图变形机制实现对不同输入网格的自适应，并配合节点掩码预训练与高效微调，该模型在保证高精度的同时实现了良好的跨组件迁移能力。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 碰撞仿真, 代理模型, 网格变形, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地解决了图神经网络在处理复杂网格拓扑时的通用性与高精度之间的矛盾。通过引入图变形（Graph Morphing）和节点掩码预训练策略，不仅克服了传统U-Net架构在不同网格结构下的限制，还显著提升了模型在跨组件迁移学习中的数据效率和预测精度，为工程仿真替代模型提供了强有力的技术支撑。

title: MixSD: Mixed Contextual Self-Distillation for Knowledge Injection
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to inject new knowledge into language models, but it often degrades pretrained capabilities such as reasoning and general-domain performance. We argue this forgetting arises because fine-tuning targets from humans or external systems diverge from the model's autoregressive distribution, forcing the optimizer to imitate low-probability token sequences. To address this problem, we propose MixSD, a simple external-teacher-free method for distribution-aligned knowledge injection. Instead of training on fixed targets, MixSD constructs supervision dynamically by mixing tokens from two conditionals of the base model itself: an expert conditional that observes the injected fact in context, and a naive conditional that reflects the model's original prior. The resulting supervision sequences preserve the factual learning signal while remaining substantially closer to the base model's distribution. We evaluate MixSD on two synthetic corpora that we construct to study factual recall and arithmetic function acquisition in a controlled setting, together with established benchmarks for open-domain factual question answering and knowledge editing. Across multiple model scales and settings, MixSD consistently achieves a better memorization-retention trade-off compared to SFT and on-policy self distillation baselines, retaining up to 100% of the base model's held-out capability while maintaining near-perfect training accuracy, whereas standard SFT retains as little as 1%. We further show that MixSD produces substantially lower-NLL supervision targets under the base model and reduces harmful movement along Fisher-sensitive parameter directions. These results suggest that aligning supervision with the model's native generation distribution is a simple and effective principle for knowledge injection that mitigates catastrophic forgetting.

title: Analyzing Error Propagation in Korean Spoken QA with ASR-LLM Cascades
summary: We analyze how automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors propagate through ASR-LLM cascades in Korean spoken question answering (SQA), focusing on downstream semantic failures that conventional ASR metrics cannot fully capture. Our analysis shows that the relative downstream degradation caused by ASR errors is consistent across LLMs with different absolute performance, suggesting that cascade degradation largely tracks ASR-stage information loss. We further identify single-character Korean ASR errors as a Korean-specific loss channel, where even a minimal transcription difference can change the intended question and degrade downstream QA performance. Finally, an auxiliary comparison shows that a large audio language model outperforms an ASR-LLM cascade with an approximately matched language backbone in noisy Korean SQA, indicating the potential of direct audio input to mitigate transcript-induced information loss.
